name: Checkbox
description: Boolean and indeterminate selection with an integrated label and description.

anatomy.description: The checkbox button holding checked, unchecked, or indeterminate state.
The check or dash mark that mirrors the tri-state value.
Clickable text wired to the control.
Optional supporting text linked through aria-describedby.

dos: Use indeterminate for a select-all parent whose children are partially checked.
Phrase labels as positive statements so checked always means yes.
Use Checkbox for choices that are saved on submit, not applied instantly.
donts: Don't use checkboxes for mutually exclusive options; use RadioGroup.
Don't use one for a setting that applies immediately; use Switch.
Don't put interactive content inside the label or description.

examples.title: Checked, indeterminate, and disabled
examples.description: Checkbox supports a tri-state checked prop for select-all patterns.

examples.title: Select-all parent
examples.description: A parent checkbox mirrors its children as checked, unchecked, or indeterminate and toggles them all.

examples.title: Bulk selection
examples.description: Use indeterminate state when a table selection contains both checked and unchecked rows.

examples.title: Permission groups
examples.description: Group independent permissions under one clear label and description.

guidance.useWhen: Users can select independent items or a tri-state group.
guidance.avoidWhen: Changing the value should take effect immediately as a setting.
guidance.behavior: Checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states remain native and form-friendly.
guidance.responsive: Allow supporting text to wrap beside the control.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to and from the checkbox.
Toggles the checkbox; indeterminate moves to checked.

notes: Supports a tri-state checked value for select-all patterns, announced as "mixed" by screen readers.
The label is clickable and the description is linked through aria-describedby.
Inside a Field, the Field label is the only rendered label; pass label only for standalone use.

props.description: Supporting text rendered below the label.
props.name: description

props.description: Visible label rendered next to the checkbox. Required outside a Field; inside a Field the Field's label is used.
props.name: label

props.description: Hides the label visually while keeping it available to screen readers.
